title: A clear answer leaves room for detail

captions.physics: Combining brief answers and personal stories
captions.emotions: Feeling proportion in what is heard

meaning: You can combine a brief answer with a personal account and develop communication, feeling fairness where details do not hide the request.
text: Temperance in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in combining a brief answer with a personal account. The Empress in energy supports the wish to develop substantial communication and give details living room. Justice in emotions brings proportion when an answer concerns the actual request. You can speak richly without hiding the main point and be specific without impoverishing the exchange. These sides meet in how you actually construct remarks.

For example, asked whether you can discuss a long letter together, you first clearly say “Today I can read the beginning”. You then explain what in the text has already interested you. **Personal detail should not conceal an actual answer**. Conversation holds both a specific possibility and living interest. Fairness appears because attention to a subject is not presented as a promise to examine everything. A limit nevertheless requires neither a dry refusal nor treating additional words as evasion.

Imbalance appears if rich detail makes the main point unrecognisable again. Combining different sides then becomes a lengthy route around an uncomfortable answer. The constructive Empress helps develop the exchange’s actual meaning. You can describe what matters and directly name what is available; substantial communication requires neither promising too much nor reducing personal interest to formal confirmation that says nothing about your relationship with the subject.
